item: Small-multiple panels carry their scale and dates and answer a hover (journalist 4d)
summary: Library > Growth by language and Insights > Trends small multiples were bare traces with the shared max in a footnote and no dates or hover. Each panel now writes the shared max at its dashed line and its first and last real dates under the baseline, and every bar or point carries its date and count as an SVG title. Journalist 4e (super-group card oversized) was already closed by #1955.
